posts.title: Critics Loved, Audiences Didn't

posts.long: Sometimes critics and audiences just don't agree. These 5 shows scored 75+ from critics but fell flat with audiences — led by The Lyons (78 critic score, D audience grade). The data doesn't lie. #Broadway #Theater #CriticsVsAudience #BroadwayScorecard

posts.title: Critics vs Audience Disagree
posts.short: The shows where critics and audiences disagree the most. Stranger Things has a 65 CriticScore but an A+ from audiences. Wicked? 69 from critics, A+ from fans.
posts.long: Where do critics and audiences disagree the most on Broadway? Stranger Things leads the gap with a 65 CriticScore but an A+ audience grade. Wicked, Great Gatsby, The Outsiders, and MJ all follow the same pattern — audiences love them, critics are lukewarm. #Broadway #Theater #CriticsVsAudience

posts.title: Toughest & Most Generous Outlets

posts.long: We ranked Broadway's toughest and most generous outlets by their average CriticScore across 20+ reviewed shows. Backstage leads the tough side at 63.8, while Digital Journal tops the generous side at 83.2 — nearly a 20-point gap. posts.title: Best Broadway Seasons
posts.short: The best Broadway seasons since 2000, ranked by average CriticScore across all shows. 2022-23 takes the crown at 72.5, led by Kimberly Akimbo (88).
posts.long: Which Broadway season had the best shows? We averaged every CriticScore since 2000. The 2022-23 season wins at 72.5, with Kimberly Akimbo (88) as its top show. 2016-17 and 2023-24 tie for second. Data from 700+ shows. #Broadway #BroadwayHistory #Theater #BroadwayScorecard

posts.title: Critics Panned, Audiences Loved

Sometimes the crowd knows best. #Broadway #Theater #Audience #BroadwayScorecard

posts.title: Fastest Recoupments
posts.short: The fastest Broadway shows to recoup their investment. Waiting for Godot made back $7.5M in just 8 weeks. Othello did it in 9. Hamilton took 10.
posts.long: How fast can a Broadway show make its money back? Waiting for Godot recouped $7.5M in just 8 weeks. Othello and Glengarry Glen Ross did it in 9. Hamilton's $12.5M took 10 weeks. These are the fastest recoupments since 2005. #Broadway #BroadwayBusiness #Theater #BroadwayScorecard

posts.title: Most Expensive Productions
posts.short: The most expensive Broadway productions ever made. King Kong cost $36.5M and flopped. Harry Potter cost $35.5M and barely trickled back. Frozen: $35M, fizzled.
posts.long: The most expensive Broadway shows ever — and what happened to them. King Kong ($36.5M) flopped. Harry Potter ($35.5M) is a slow trickle. Frozen ($35M) fizzled. Death Becomes Her ($31.5M) is TBD. Boop ($29M) just flopped. Big budgets don't guarantee success. #Broadway #BroadwayBusiness #Theater

posts.title: Hamilton Scorecard
posts.short: Hamilton by the numbers: 90 CriticScore, A+ audience grade, 42 scored reviews. Tier 3 critics actually rate it highest at 91.7. The data behind the phenomenon.
posts.long: The full Broadway Scorecard breakdown for Hamilton. 90 CriticScore from 42 reviews, A+ audience grade. Interesting: Tier 3 critics (blogs, smaller outlets) rate it highest at 91.7, even above Tier 1 (89.4). The show's appeal is universal. #Hamilton #Broadway #Theater #BroadwayScorecard

posts.title: Wicked Scorecard
posts.short: Do critics agree with audiences on Wicked? Not really. 69 CriticScore vs A+ audience grade. Tier 3 critics (79.2) liked it way more than Tier 1 (66.3).
posts.long: Wicked has an A+ audience grade but only a 69 CriticScore — one of Broadway's biggest critic-audience gaps. Tier 1 critics (NYT, Variety) averaged just 66.3, while Tier 3 outlets gave it 79.2. After 20+ years and a hit movie, critics still aren't fully on board. #Wicked #Broadway #Theater

posts.title: Lion King Scorecard
posts.short: 28 years later, The Lion King by the numbers. 83 CriticScore, A+ audience grade, consistent across all three critic tiers. A true Critical Gold show.
posts.long: The Lion King has been on Broadway for 28 years. Here's what the data says: 83 CriticScore (Critical Gold), A+ audience grade, and remarkably consistent scores across all critic tiers (T1: 84, T2: 83.8, T3: 81.8). A certified classic. #TheLionKing #Broadway #Theater #BroadwayScorecard

posts.title: Harry Potter Scorecard
posts.short: What do 69 critics think of Harry Potter on Broadway? 83 CriticScore (Critical Gold), A- audience grade. Tier 1 critics rate it highest at 87.
posts.long: Harry Potter and the Cursed Child has 69 scored reviews — more than almost any Broadway show. The verdict: 83 CriticScore (Critical Gold), A- audience grade. Tier 1 critics (NYT, Variety, Vulture) are the most enthusiastic at 87. #HarryPotter #CursedChild #Broadway #Theater

posts.title: Ragtime Scorecard
posts.short: Ragtime is back on Broadway — here's what critics think. 81 CriticScore (Recommended), A audience grade. Tier 3 critics love it most at 87, Tier 1 is cooler at 77.
posts.long: Ragtime returned to Broadway in 2025 and here's the full scorecard: 81 CriticScore (Recommended), A audience grade from fans. The split is interesting — Tier 3 critics love it at 87, while Tier 1 (NYT, Variety) are cooler at 77. #Ragtime #Broadway #Theater #BroadwayScorecard
